outcome: gestational age at delivery (extreme preterm, very preterm, moderately preterm, early term, full term, late term, post-term)
cohort: The study included 479,864 singleton live births from 13 maternity units in England between 1990 and 2007.
finding: There was a J-shaped association between maternal BMI categories and the absolute risk of extreme, very, and moderate preterm birth, while the absolute risk of post-term birth increased monotonically with BMI category, with class IIIb obesity having the greatest risks for inadequate gestational age.
gest_age: 20 weeks gestation to >=42 weeks gestation (categorized for analysis)
